roles.title: Staff Product Manager, Intelligent Customer Experience

bullets: Own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for Calendly’s intelligent customer experience, spanning AI support quality, automated resolution, and human escalation
Increase automated resolution by enabling the Support Agent to accurately answer questions and take actions on behalf of customers, while reserving human support for high-value…
Define and improve AI quality , including answer accuracy, resolution quality, escalation effectiveness, and the failure modes that prevent customers from getting the right outcome
Build the measurement and observability layer for Agent/Bot Quality Score, automated resolution rate, customer experience cycle time, escalation routing, and customer satisfaction
Establish and drive adoption of a company-wide “supportability contract” so every new Calendly capability is supportable by AI agents, automation, or human support from day one
Understand the work that surrounds meetings for our users: what they’re trying to accomplish, where they lose time, and which of those problems are worth solving and how to solve…
Turn those problems into an assistant that helps at the right moments
Earn enough trust in the assistant’s output that users are willing to hand it more autonomy over time, letting it act without reviewing every step.
Ship fast and learn in the open: get real versions in front of users, watch how they respond, and iterate quickly.
Build engagement as a system, not a pile of one-off campaigns: the ranking, the timing, the triggers that compound into a habit
Own the surfaces where Calendly shows users their next step, in-product and over email, and the craft of getting the right thing in front of the right person at the right moment
Build the habit of returning without ever making the product feel noisy
Ship fast and learn on real usage
